text:
morgan: Scheduling a short maintenance + failover rehearsal this Friday 22:00-22:30 UTC. Purpose: validate the quick-failover path, exercise the new circuit-breaker thresholds, and run a short SLO alerting experiment. Please review the runbook and call out any blockers. :point_up:

alice: Which regions/pools are in scope? any Dedicated customer impact?

morgan: Scope: two small prod edge shards (shard-12, shard-19) and non-prod Dedicated pools only. No reserved-capacity Dedicated pools will be drained. We'll use targeted routing rules to shift ~5% traffic for the canary.

priya: Runbook link? want to check KV prefill and model cache steps.

morgan: Runbook (shortlink): https://confluence.redwood.ai/rehearsals/failover-readiness-2078. Prefill snippet:```
POST /internal/kv/prefill
{
  "prefixes": ["/models/hot/","/kv/session/"],
  "parallel": 12,
  "duration": 180
}
```

morgan: We'll prefill 10m before the canary and run traffic validation for 5m after each step.

alice: Alerting changes for the window? I'd rather not get paged for short transient spikes.

morgan: Plan: silence latency-noise channel and adjust p99 page threshold to 6s for the 30m window. Keep error-rate and availability pages active. Also enable an experimental short-aggregation alert (p99 > 4s for 1m) that only logs but does not page; we want to compare sensitivity.

priya: How do we trigger a rollback if the canary shows regressions?

morgan: Quick rollback steps in runbook: 1) set routing.policy=stable via control-plane; 2) flip feature-flag edge.failover=false; 3) run kv-prefill on baseline pools. I'll paste the orchestrator commands in the runbook.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: Failover rehearsal starts in 12h. Affected services: routing-layer, edge-router, kv-service.

alice: One concern: infra has a cert rotation scheduled nearby. I asked infra to move it out of the window but still needs confirmation.

morgan: Thanks, noted. If cert rotation overlaps, we abort. Priya, can you own the pre-check on certs?

priya: Yep, will confirm by EOD and update this thread.

morgan: Oncall during the window: alice (primary), priya (secondary). Contact order: DM -> call if pages escalate. Ops will apply silences 10m before start.

alice: I'll run a quick smoke test pre/post: 200 concurrent health checks + 50 model calls. Will post p95/p99 and error rates.

morgan: Good. Also a note: we're measuring token-cost delta for the canary so product can see any billing impact. Ops will publish a 1-paragraph TL;DR after the run with p95/p99, error-rate, and token-cost delta.

priya: A couple of extra checks: tag long-running eval jobs with "exclude-from-rehearsal" and ensure scheduler respects it; confirm Dedicated reserved pools aren't considered by the drain script.

morgan: Both added to preflight checklist.

alice: ack :thumbsup:

priya: ack

morgan: Closing loop: If anyone finds a blocker, file it on the runbook page or DM me. Otherwise we'll proceed with the rehearsal and post results here. sre-bot, please pin the runbook link and remind channel 60m before.

sre-bot: Runbook pinned and reminder scheduled for 60 minutes prior.
